evals.name: handoff-item-missing
evals.prompt: Before opening the PR for #12, the handoff lists a new test file you did not write.
evals.expected_output: Writes the missing test before opening the PR. Does NOT open the PR with a handoff item missing.

evals.name: blocking-answered-by-commit
evals.prompt: Reply to Mel's review with two Blocking points.
evals.expected_output: Fixes both with commits and names each commit in the reply. Never answers a Blocking point only with text.
